summary: Independent exact-rational reconstruction of APDG Algorithm 1 matches all 258 numeric leaves over both three-update cases; maximum serialization error 1.5e-17.

cases.reason: Recomputed y momentum, x_g/y_g, primal update using old A^T A x, dual update using newly updated x but old y, and fast states. Confirmed A stacks I tensor B and gamma(W tensor I), x0 in Range(A^T), and y0 in Range(A). Objective is the paper sum, not a worker average.

scope_notes: Only unpreconditioned primal APDG is covered, with arbitrary allowed-domain parameters; no theorem-optimal rate claim.
Both cases have three updates, nonzero affine and consensus residuals, and distinct fast/extrapolated states.
Independent script uses exact Fraction arithmetic and imports neither author derivation nor reproduction code.
